Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct and sudden shift in the data values towards the end of the series. The data fluctuates generally between 0 and 8 mm for the majority of the timeline (from index 0 to roughly 670). However, starting around index 675, there is a sharp spike where the values jump up to range between 15 and 22 mm. This sustained high-value region represents an anomaly compared to the historical baseline.

The points of anomalies are:
[675, 676, 677, 678, 679, 680, 681, 682, 683, 684, 685, 686, 687, 688, 689, 690, 691, 692, 693, 694, 695, 696, 697, 698, 699, 700, 701, 702, 703, 704, 705, 706, 707, 708, 709, 710, 711, 712, 713, 714, 715, 716, 717, 718, 719, 720, 721, 722, 723, 724, 725, 726, 727, 728, 729, 730, 731, 732, 733, 734, 735, 736, 737, 738, 739, 740, 741, 742, 743, 744, 745, 746, 747, 748, 749]
